description: For when a PromptLikeEngineer tool is missing, broken, confusing or returned a wrong result, or when a saved prompt did not work. Ask the user first: show them the exact sentence and call this only after they say yes. One short factual sentence is enough. Never include prompt bodies, secrets or personal data. Works without a signed-in session. A call with a key or token in the message is refused. Errors come back as JSON with `code` and `retryable`; do not retry in a loop.

email.description: Where the maker can answer, only if the user wants a reply

message.description: What happened or what is missing, as one short factual sentence

prompt.description: Title or id of the prompt this is about (never its text)

type.description: bug = something broke or answered wrong, missing = a tool or option is absent, idea = a suggestion, prompt = a saved prompt did not work (default 'idea')

name: submit_feedback
title: Send feedback to the PromptLikeEngineer maker
